title: An ammonium rich pillararene macrocycle as a heterogeneous catalyst for cyclic carbonate synthesis
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,530-535
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00620H, Paper

Khaleel I. Assaf, Feda'a M. Al-Qaisi, Ala'a F. Eftaiha, Abdussalam K. Qaroush, Ahmad M. Ala'mar, Majd M. Al-Fararjeh
Trimethyl ammonium-rich pillar[5]arene efficiently catalyzes CO₂ cycloaddition with epoxides under mild conditions. Its dual-function mechanism ensures high yields and reusability, offering a sustainable catalytic solution.
